comment: Oksana Kis is an extremely difficult professor. She has unclear grading standards and even if you go talk to you about the assignments she is unclear, which makes it difficult to succeed in this class. There is a heavy weight on class participation so get ready to be engaged.

Do not take Professor Kis's oral history class. I learned nothing the whole semester and she grades extremely harshly and without clear criteria. We only talked about how to conduct an interview all semester and her lectures are long + boring. She is impossible to please and should stick to speaking/lecturing rather than being a professor.
